purpose: Prospectively test whether a deterministic incomplete-generation fallback converts conservative Qwen3.6 model-owned commit transfer into a positive GPT-OSS-120B result on a second untouched MMLU-Pro identity set.
scientific_classification: new-source prospective reliability confirmation; selector weights, semantic margin, reliability veto, source-ranking seed, decoding, and success criteria frozen before source selection, candidate generation, or scoring

development_evidence.post_hoc_boundary: The reliability rule was chosen after the listed outcomes were available. Neither listed identity set can confirm it; both are development evidence only.

selector.reliability_rule: If and only if the semantic selector chose revision and that revision completion is empty or max_token_exhausted is true, deterministically retain unchanged instead.

gpt_oss_120b_confirmation.selection_rule: lowest SHA256(seed NUL identity) ranks after excluding the public screen, every prior Q36 external identity, and the first source-disjoint confirmation

execution.score_phase: single dependent CPU job after all candidate generation
execution.analysis_phase: single dependent CPU job after sealed selections and score

predeclared_success.capability: selected correct count is strictly greater than unchanged
predeclared_success.retention: selected output retains at least 95 percent of unchanged-correct identities
predeclared_success.benchmark_success: selected correct count is nonnegative versus unchanged on MMLU-Pro
predeclared_success.strict_confirmation_pass: capability and retention and benchmark_success are all true

prohibitions: no selector, GPT-OSS revision, or reliability-rule retraining after this freeze
no threshold, reliability rule, source-ranking seed, prompt, decoding, shard, or success-gate change
no assessor access during preparation, fixed-draft generation, GPT generation, or selection
no task, correctness, host, or assessor label in the model projection or deterministic veto
no duplicate generation or scoring job
no mutation of prior candidate, score, selection, or result artifacts
